stations.title: Local model
stations.note: Once it said dogs ride free.

captions: The box finds the right pieces. Now a customer asks if dogs can ride in kayaks.
A trial chatbot once said dogs ride free. It answered from nothing.
You write the answer step: numbered sources, citations and an honest no.
Now the answer comes from the dogs article and names it as its source.
Every answer shows where it came from, or says the handbook has nothing.
